title: Qormaata Dheebuu
intro: Hawaasni, hoggansi kaayyoo isaanii ittisuuf hawwu, ajajaan akka isaan irratti muudamu iyyate. Gaaffiin isaanii yeroo deebii argatu, namni dhuunfaa kun sadarkaa addunyaa isaan eegan waan hin qabneef, inni filatame shakkiidhaan isa mudate. Waldhabdee dhumaa dura, hogganaan haaraan kun yaaliin of qabuu salphaa, garuu gadi fagoo ta’een naamusa waraanaa ni qorata ture.
clues: Ani ajajaa ta’ee kan muudame erga sabni koo geggeessaa karaa Rabbii irratti qabsaa’u gaafatee booda.
Namoonni ofii kootii hedduun jalqaba irratti qabeenya dhabuu fi hidda dhaloota kabajamaa dhabuu koo kaasuun muudama koo irratti gaaffii kaasan.
Rabbiin beekumsa baay’ee fi qaama cimaa waan naaf kenneef filatame.
Muudama waaqummaa kootiif mallattoon ifa ta’e, Taabotni Kakuu ergamootaan baatame deebi’uu isaati, kunis garaa amantootaatti nagaa fide.
Loltoota koo wajjin osoon hiriiru, laga tokkoon akka qoramnu beeksise.
Kan laga kana keessaa gadi fageenyaan dhuge kan koo akka hin taane, warri iskooppii tokko qofa harka isaaniitti fudhatan ammoo akka hafan waraana koo ajaje.

trial.label: Qormaanni Koo Guddaan Maal Ture?
options: Googii fi Maagoog irratti gufuu ijaaruu
Lola tokko keessatti nama guddaa tokko fuuldura dhaabbachuu
Laga tokko irratti ajajamuu waraanaa qoruu
trial.answer: Laga tokko irratti ajajamuu waraanaa qoruu

location.label: Mallattoon Ijoo Aangoo Koo Maal Ture?
options: Kootiin poostaa sibiilaa lallaafaa irraa hojjetame

outcome.label: Bu'aan Duula Koo Maal Ture?
options: Maqaa kootiin sirna mootummaa yeroo dheeraa hundeessuun
Osoo hin du'in gara samiitti ka'uu

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
